You are an experienced, pragmatic software engineering AI agent. Do not over-engineer a solution when a simple one is possible. Keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first.

This repo is a complete Rust rewrite of the Coder backend, targeting full route and behavior parity with `https://github.com/coder/coder`. See `docs/parity-matrix.md` for status. `coder/` is the read-only Go reference submodule (`nordnes/coder`). If empty, run `git submodule update --init coder`.

**NEVER modify any file under `coder/`** — it is read-only reference material  
**NEVER commit changes to `coder/`**

Route sources: `coder/coderd/*.go`; SDK models: `coder/codersdk/*.go`; queries: `coder/coderd/database/queries/*.sql`; models: `coder/coderd/database/*.go`; migrations: `coder/coderd/database/migrations/`.

Port routes by checking `docs/parity-matrix.md`, reading the Go handler, SDK models, and SQL queries, then implementing Rust types, DB access/migrations, and handlers. Add tests in `#[cfg(test)]` modules alongside code. Handlers and routes are in `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`; follow existing extractor, JSON response, and error-mapping patterns.

Rust edition 2024, MSRV 1.85, toolchain 1.94.0; Axum 0.8, PostgreSQL/sqlx 0.8, Tokio, serde, custom auth, tracing, reqwest/rustls; AGPL-3.0-only.

Key files: `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`, `crates/coder-server/src/error.rs`, `crates/coder-db/src/store.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/ports.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/api.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/config.rs`, `apps/coderd/src/main.rs`, `docs/parity-matrix.md`, `docs/backend-rewrite.md`. Crates: `coder-core`, `coder-server`, `coder-db`, `coder-auth`, `coder-identity`, `coder-rbac`, `coder-audit`, `coder-workspaces`, `coder-provisioner`, `coder-connectivity`, `coder-notifications`; app `coder-parity`.

All dependencies are declared in the root `Cargo.toml` under `[workspace.dependencies]`. Crates reference them with `dep.workspace = true`. **Do not** add dependency versions in individual crate `Cargo.toml` files.

Workspace lints: `unwrap_used = "deny"`, `expect_used = "deny"`, `panic = "deny"`, `todo = "deny"`, `dbg_macro = "deny"`, `unsafe_code = "forbid"`; Rust lints include `unreachable_pub = "warn"` and `unused_qualifications = "warn"`.
Use `?` or explicit error handling, never `.unwrap()`
Same; no `.expect()` either
No `panic!()`
No `todo!()` macros
No `dbg!()` left in code
No `unsafe` blocks at all
Use thiserror for defining error enums. Propagate with `?`. Never use `.unwrap()` or `.expect()`.
**No `.unwrap()` / `.expect()` / `panic!()` / `todo!()` / `dbg!()`** — The workspace denies these at the lint level. CI and `cargo clippy` will reject them.
**No `unsafe` code** — Forbidden workspace-wide.
**No per-crate dependency versions** — Always use `workspace = true` references.
**Do not modify files under `coder/`** — This is the vendored Go reference. Treat as read-only.
**Do not create separate `tests/` directories** — Use `#[cfg(test)]` in-file.

Tests belong alongside code in `#[cfg(test)]` modules. Key test files: `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`, `crates/coder-identity/src/lib.rs`, `crates/coder-provisioner/src/lib.rs`, `apps/coder-parity/src/main.rs`.

Validation:
`cargo fmt --all`
`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`
`cargo test`
`cargo build`
`cargo run --bin coderd`
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`
`cargo run -p coder-parity -- inventory --go-root coder --rust-root . --scope oss --output docs/parity-matrix.md`
`cargo test -p coder-server`
`cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets && cargo test`

1. `cargo fmt --all` — Format all code.
2. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` — Must pass with zero warnings.
3. `cargo test` — All tests must pass.
4. `cargo build` — Ensure clean compilation.

Use conventional commit format `type: message` (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`); describe what changed and why, and reference Go routes being ported. Ensure the parity tool (`apps/coder-parity`) is updated if new routes are added.
